Priya (People Ops): Heads-up — candidate for SDE-2 onsite just got moved to 2:00pm today. Need quick cover for the panel + someone to own the debrief notes. Current panel listed on the event: Samir, Elena, Jordan, Mei. @samir can you step in if Jordan can't? Also quick rubric Q below.

Samir (ML Infra): I can cover 2–3pm if Jordan's blocked. Not available after 3. Would prefer the handoff at 1:50 so I can pre-read the takehome. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Backend): I have a calendar conflict at 2 — can't make the live session. I can pre-score the take-home and join the debrief at 3pm. Please reassign live interviewer.

Elena (Eng): I can jump in for the design slot if needed. @priya can you update the calendar and add the Zoom link? Also nominate a debrief owner — happy to help but low on bandwidth right after.

Mei (Hiring Coord): I can own the debrief and capture notes if that's helpful. Candidate consent for recording is on file. Quick debrief checklist I use:
```
1) start recording at 1:55
2) assign scribe (Mei -> will do)
3) collect rubric PDFs in #hiring-rubrics
4) submit consolidated eval within 24h
```

Priya (People Ops): Thanks — I've updated the event: swapped Jordan -> Samir for the live interview, added a 10m buffer, and set Mei as debrief owner. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890. @samir can you confirm you can be on at 1:50 for handoff? :white_check_mark:

InterviewBot: Event updated: "SDE-2 Onsite" — 2026-03-27 14:00. Attendees updated. Recording enabled.

Samir (ML Infra): Confirmed. I'll join at 1:50, pre-read the take-home, and cover live from 2–3pm.

Priya (People Ops): Great — Mei will lead the debrief. One rubric clarification before we close: treat "communication" as 15 pts for overall clarity + 5 pts for code readability within the implementation section (so total 20). We'll normalize scores across panels afterward. Thanks everyone :rocket:
